Replace the stacked BJT ΔVbe core with a weak-inversion NMOS β-multiplier (~1.0 V stack). Keep the Vbe+PTAT·R2 output with an R3 divider and the existing start-up circuit."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (0.4e-6, 0.2e-6, 0.7e-6),
    "gmid_n": (22.0, 18.0, 26.0),
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "K":      (8.0, 4.0, 16.0),
    "gmid_p": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "Lp":     (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),
    "tc_trim":(1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "vtgt":   (0.95, 0.93, 0.97),
    "Cpg":    (5e-12, 1e-12, 10e-12),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]
    K = p["K"]
    T0 = 300.15

    def veb(i, m, T=T0):
        v27 = 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(i, 1e-12) / (10e-6 * m))
        return v27 - 2.0e-3 * (T - T0)

    # PMOS mirror (M1, M2 diode, M5 output)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.6)
    vpg = 1.8 - mp.vgs

    # NMOS beta-multiplier: M3 diode (source vss), M4 = K*W with R1 in its source
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.45)
    W4 = mn.W * K
    vx = 0.06
    vgs4 = mn.vgs - 0.06
    for _ in range(6):
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.2
        for _ in range(50):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            try:
                idm = lut.op("n", W4, mn.L, mid, max(vpg - vx, 0.1), vx)["Id"]
            except Exception:
                idm = 0.0
            if idm > I:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        vgs4 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        vx = max(mn.vgs - vgs4, 0.01)
    R1 = vx / I

    # Output stage: PTAT current Io into (R2 + Q3) || R3
    Io = I
    vt = p["vtgt"]
    Iq = 0.5 * Io
    R2 = R3 = 1e6
    for _ in range(30):
        v3 = veb(Iq, 1)
        dveb = (v3 - 1.2 - 3 * UT) / T0
        R2 = p["tc_trim"] * (-dveb) * T0 / Io
        vbg = v3 + Io * R2
        k = min(max(vt / vbg, 0.3), 0.98)
        R3 = k * R2 / (1 - k)
        Iq = max(Io - vt / R3, 0.02e-6)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Io, vds=1.8 - vt)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.dev("M2", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "na", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M3", "na", "na", "vss", "vss", mn)
    n.M("M4", "pg", "na", "x", "vss", "nfet", W4, mn.L)
    n.R("R1", "x", "vss", R1)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", p["Cpg"])
    n.C("Cout", "vref", "vss", 2e-12)

    # start-up: sx high only when vref low -> pull pg down
    n.M("Msp", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("Msn", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms",  "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)

    v3 = veb(Iq, 1)
    vref_pred = (R3 / (R2 + R3)) * (v3 + Io * R2)
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 0.05e-6)
    lam = mp.gds / max(mp.Id, 1e-15)
    rp = R2 * R3 / (R2 + R3)
    line_reg = lam * Io * rp + 0.01
    psrr = -db(max(line_reg, 1e-4))
    return n, {
        "vref": vref_pred,
        "tc_ppm": 150.0,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "power": power,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
```
